title: Paid, but still pending
ticket: Orders created in tests get marked paid fine. Orders loaded from the database stay 'pending' after the payment goes through.
explanation: is checks whether two names point at the same object, not whether two strings are equal. The literal 'pending' in a test is often the same interned object, so the check passes. A status read from the database is a new string object with the same text, so is returns False and the order is never marked paid.
